correctness.rationale: Complete parity proof: factors of length >=2 contain zero, images have nonempty ones solely on odd positions, so no odd cyclic conjugating shift exists. Even shifts descend uniquely through the injective length-two code. Every length-2n factor arises from one of the two substitution phases, yielding surjectivity. Length one handled separately. Enumeration of first 100 lengths supports, but does not replace, proof.

The new class-level dyadic bijection is strictly stronger: c(2n)=c(n) for arbitrary n, preserving every odd-part class profile. value.rationale: Natural whole-profile invariant for the cyclic factor complexity of a classical morphic word: not just its known minimal subsequence c(2^k)=2, but a lossless bijection of all factor necklace classes at every doubled length. This gives exact reductions of all even-length instances to their odd parts and isolates the mechanism of parity recognizability; this is a structural class-level result, not a recomputation of a finite table.
